-- Phase 1: spec only. Bodies are stubs until Phase 2.

-- Pure helper: upper-cases one string.
shout_line(s: str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() == s.char_count()
  ex shout_line("ab") == "AB"
  ex shout_line("") == ""
  s.upper()

-- Prints each string of xs upper-cased, one per line.
-- Note: the ex line below is from the frozen spec. It compares a
-- no-result function to None, so it may need revising later.
shout(xs: List[str]) uses io =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  ex shout([]) == None
  for s in xs
    io.print(shout_line(s))
